name: functional-todo-application
description: Build a Functional To-Do Application - Full-Stack React & Node.js Solution

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix server start" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.vercel-build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.test: npm test --prefix client && npm test --prefix server
